publication_policy: Only publish opportunities with an official scholarship or funding source, clear eligibility, award details, deadline or application cycle, and a last-verified date. Empty dataset means no scholarships have yet been verified; do not display invented examples.
nationality_input_policy: Students may select and save more than one nationality. Keep each nationality as a separate ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code; do not infer citizenship from country of residence.
eligibility_matching_policy: For a student with multiple nationalities, evaluate each nationality separately against the official provider rules. A match on at least one nationality may qualify only if the provider's rules do not impose a restriction on dual or multiple citizenship. If rules are unclear, conflict, or have not been checked, show eligibility as unknown and direct the student to the official source; do not label the opportunity eligible.
nationality_code_standard: Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes for nationality and residence fields. Use the special value ALL only when the official provider explicitly confirms eligibility for applicants of all nationalities.

record_schema.title: Official scholarship or funding opportunity name
record_schema.eligible_nationalities: Array of ISO alpha-3 codes; use ALL only when explicitly confirmed; otherwise use an empty array when unknown
record_schema.excluded_nationalities: Array of ISO alpha-3 codes only when exclusions are explicitly stated
record_schema.eligible_residencies: Array of ISO alpha-3 codes or ALL only when officially stated; keep separate from nationality
record_schema.host_countries: Array of ISO alpha-3 destination country codes
record_schema.eligible_fields: Array of eligible or restricted programme/field labels; empty when not specified
record_schema.funding_type: full | partial | stipend | tuition_only | other | unknown
record_schema.funding_coverage: Officially stated costs covered; do not infer full funding
record_schema.notes: Relevant official conditions, including dual/multiple-citizenship restrictions and uncertainty
